dialog: Uh... Do you feel it too, @NAME?
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 1
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: The air feels... rarefied.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 2
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: Like it's charged.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 3
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: I was hoping that getting away from Vigilaris would give us a bit more peace.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 4
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: After all, we've left Holdric behind, and the city in good hands.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 5
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: But... couldn't be further from the truth.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 6
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: Order may feel like a relief at first, but after a while...
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 7
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: It only makes the scars more obvious.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 8
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: All this silence... isn't peace.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 9
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: It's the harbinger of a storm.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 10
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: Look at the clouds. They're suspended.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 11
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: Trapped as they waver between becoming a tempest or a downpour.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 12
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 13
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: Sorry, I know I'm rambling.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 14
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: Everything gives me the feeling of a still, apathetic anxiety.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 15
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: Wanting to be without taking action.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 16
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: And... I think, in some way, that resonates with me...
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 17
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: ... But I didn't want to lose focus.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 18
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: Come on, @NAME. Let's get moving again.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER 19
chapter: 21 EXT. CAMINO REAL - AMANECER

dialog: Yuck…
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 1
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: @NAME, look at this.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 2
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: The ground is getting… sticky.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 3
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: And it's not mud….
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 4
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: It's… resin?
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 5
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: It seems to come from the trees' roots.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 6
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: But… why?
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 7
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Why would these trees expel their own healing sap by themselves?
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 8
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Could they be… producing more than they should be producing?
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 9
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: How curious…
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 10
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: It feels as if the passage of time were crushing them.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 11
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Forcing them to shed their own vital substances…
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 12
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: … simply because they produce far more than they can use.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 13
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Let's keep going, @NAME.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 14
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: But let's move calmly and carefully.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 15
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: The more we try to run, the more we'll end up trapped by this forest.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 16
chapter: 22 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Ugh...
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 1
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: @NAME, are you okay?
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 2
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: What exhausting enemies...
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 3
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: Facing them is like trying to read a book in a junk shop.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 4
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: Still... I admit I feel a bit of compassion for them.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 5
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: For a moment, I felt like they needed to beat us.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 6
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: They needed that victory.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 7
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: But we can't take risks right now...
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 8
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: One wrong step could leave us out of action for far too long.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 9
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: And right now, time is running out.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 10
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: Maybe in the future we can stop and talk to some of them.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 11
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: Maybe that way, no one will have to suffer the bitterness of defeat.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER 12
chapter: 23 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO II - AMANECER

dialog: Hey, look up there.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 1
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: See that substance dripping from the upper branches?
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 2
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Across Mindveil, it goes by many names...
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 3
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Though maybe the most common is "Tear of Torpor".
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 4
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: They say some corrupt alchemists collect it to distill Elixirs of Euphoria...
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 5
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Apparently, a single drop of these elixirs can make anyone feel an unparalleled sense of ecstasy.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 6
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: As if you'd achieved all your goals at once, in a matter of seconds.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 7
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: But don't let that feeling fool you...
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 8
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: That's exactly what makes them sweet poisons.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 9
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Once you've tried them, it's hard not to develop a dependence on them...
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 10
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: ...or to accept sacrifice as something necessary for satisfaction ever again.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 11
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Anyway... I think that makes my opinion on the matter clear.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 12
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: The farther we stay from these substances, the better!
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 13
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: I assure you that in the future we'll be able to feel just as ecstatic without having to turn to them.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 14
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: And more importantly: by our own merits.
name: EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER 15
chapter: 24 EXT. BOSQUE PERIFÉRICO - AMANECER

dialog: Hey, @NAME...
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 1
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: I should take advantage of these moments to tell you more about Mindveil's current state.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 2
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: After all, I'm your guide, right?
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 3
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: Let's see, let me think...
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 4
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: There's a detail that's been with us since you arrived.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 5
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: ...And I'm sure you haven't overlooked it.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 6
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: The monsters here are very, very restless.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 7
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: It's as if they're afraid of being frozen in place.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 8
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: But the most interesting thing is that it isn't something exclusive to the monsters.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 9
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: People can't rest either, not even in the most critical moments.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 10
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: Remember how eager that royal guard at the castle was to get back to his duties, after days shut in...
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 11
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: Without even resting.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 12
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: It's as if by doing more, they felt freer, or in tune with what's expected of them.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 13
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: As if satisfaction were always in the next step, the next object, the next encounter.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 14
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: An endless race against their very selves.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 15
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: I know all of this is kind of sad...
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 16
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: But maybe we can make use of it somehow.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 17
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: Let's keep it in mind the next time we have to negotiate with someone... or put down some creature.
name: EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER 18
chapter: 25 EXT. CAMINO REAL II - AMANECER

dialog: @NAME… Look at the horizon.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 1
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: Do you see those distant flashes?
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 2
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: I think that…
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 3
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: I think they match the location of Hushgrove.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 4
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: And they don't look like torch fire… or mana crystals…
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 5
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: Ah…
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 6
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: It can't be…
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 7
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: I can't believe the horde is already there.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 8
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: But all that artifice… It can't be anything else.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 9
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: @NAME, be careful with your perception from here on.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 10
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: It's possible that, as we get closer to the village, you'll feel your senses overwhelmed.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 11
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: All those lights and stimuli…
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 12
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: They hurt just to look at.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 13
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: It'll be hard to fight in that state.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 14
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: But, in those moments of weakness, we must make a conscious effort to isolate ourselves from the outside.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 15
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: Focus our attention. Look the fire in the eye.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 16
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: If at any moment you need help, fix your focus on me or on our objective.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 17
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: I'll be by your side when you need me.
name: EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER 18
chapter: 26 EXT. COLINA DEL VIGÍA - AMANECER

dialog: Alright, @NAME... We've arrived.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 1
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: We're at the gates of Hushgrove.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 2
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Look at all those lights, see how the village radiates heat...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 3
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Listen to the footsteps, the creaks, the knocks against the rock.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 4
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: There's no doubt the horde is still in there...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 5
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Though I hope the whole village has already gotten to safety.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 6
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Either way, we need to check as soon as possible.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 7
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Are you ready to step into the hornet's nest, @NAME?
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 8
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Once we go in, silence will be a luxury we can't afford.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 9
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Attack!
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 10
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: That's what I like to hear!
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 11
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: With that attitude, and with my unquestionable power...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 12
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: There will be nothing and no one in there that can stand against us!
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 13
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: I need to do something first.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 14
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: I understand, @NAME.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 15
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: I think it's worth making sure we're well prepared for this raid.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 16
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: One small mistake... and it could be our last.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 17
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Let me know when you're ready.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 18
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Although...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 19
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Before we set foot in there, I have to confess something.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 20
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: It's complicated... but I'll be quick.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 21
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: As we drew closer to the village, I felt something inside me that wasn't working the way it should.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 22
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Honestly, I was burning with the desire to arrive.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 23
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: But truth be told, it was becoming less and less genuine worry for the village...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 24
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: ...and more an overwhelming curiosity to find out what had happened to them, and to the horde.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 25
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: I knew the village was in trouble, and yet my mind only craved knowledge.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 26
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Knowing what we're up against. What the people of the town faced. Seeing something new.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 27
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: But I know myself, and I know I'm not like that.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 28
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: And I'm your guide. I can't afford to wander off like this.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 29
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: We all break sometimes. You can lean on me.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 30
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Thank you from the bottom of my heart, @NAME.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 31
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: This means a lot to me...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 32
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: And, in a way, I feel like it's not fair to you.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 33
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: I'm the one who's supposed to light your way in dark moments...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 34
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: But I won't refuse your support if I feel I need it.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 35
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: We're a team, after all... right?
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 36
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: You're under the influence of this realm.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 37
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: It's possible...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 38
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: I admit I had thought that too...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 39
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: I don't recognize myself, so the simplest thing is to assume something is influencing me like this.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 40
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Though part of me feels like that's an excuse.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 41
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Anyway, if you think so too, maybe I should ignore that part.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 42
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: So I really appreciate you saying it.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 43
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: A thousand thanks, @NAME. For supporting me without any obligation to do so.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 44
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: We're a team!
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 45
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: I'll let it slide... this time.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 46
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Ouch...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 47
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: Thank you, @NAME...
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 48
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: I'm so sorry I've disappointed you with my attitude.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 49
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

dialog: From now on, I'll do everything I can not to let myself be carried away by these invasive thoughts.
name: EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER 50
chapter: 27 EXT. PUERTAS DE LA ALDEA - AMANECER

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: But I woke up early out of habit.

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: I miss change. The feeling that something matters.

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: In this village, you don't live slowly. You live numb.

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Read "I miss you"

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Today I thought about you again.
name: INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 39
chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: It had been a while since it happened...
name: INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 40
chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: ...But there's a part of me that can't help falling back into the same loops.

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: I always admired your ambition. That desire to see everything, understand everything, without waiting for anything.
name: INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 42
chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: That head of yours kept you from being present in the here and now...

chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: You could barely even finish a sentence without jumping to a new one!
name: INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 44
chapter: 211 INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: And I remember I used to scold you for not living in the present.
name: INT. CASA INTACTA DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 45

chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 8
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Did he have an escape plan prepared?

dialog: It can't be...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 10

name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 11

dialog: Alright... Let's breathe.

dialog: Let's analyze the situation.

chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: I have information about Parpadeo that I think I'd like to share with you.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 14
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: I think it could give us clues about what happened.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 15
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: You see, Parpadeo...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 16
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Long ago, he was one of the few children who lived in this very village.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 17
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: He breathed life into our town.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 18
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: We all remember his liveliness, his courage, his constant drive to improve.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 19
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: A one-of-a-kind boy...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 20
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: ...With boundless ambition.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 21
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: There came a time when his desire to take on the world betrayed him.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 22
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: They made him choose between what he loved and what he needed.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 23
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: And he chose to renounce his own roots.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 24
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: He mistook freedom for debauchery.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 25
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: He looted his own family and friends. He razed everything he could...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 26
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: And then he disappeared.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 27
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Now... It seems he has some kind of connection to the Siren, the tyrant of the north.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 28
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: She uses him as her personal messenger, or something like that...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 29
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: And he sows chaos wherever he goes, shaping the fate of all who cross his path.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 30
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: He distracts them. He seduces them. He turns them from their path.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 31
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Anyway... I think he may have used the Siren's powers to get out of this situation.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 32
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: And it's possible that, after the battle and the assault on the village, he'll seek shelter in her lair to heal his wounds.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 33
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Let me think for a moment about all this...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 34
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Parpadeo is undoubtedly fast...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 35
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: But we've seen that he's not invincible.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 36
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: His power is limited. And as such, it would make sense that he'd need to recover.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 37
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: He's a being who seems to enjoy chaos... It may even be his source of energy.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 38
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Uhm...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 39
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Alright... I think I see it clearly now.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 40
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Chaos is much more intense in the north of the kingdom, where the Cataclysm was greater.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 41
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: In the north, the land is badly fractured, the laws of physics don't work as they should...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 42
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: ...And the noise is heavy and distressing. Just like the one Parpadeo was making.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 43
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: I have no doubt that we must head there.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 44
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: We have to find Parpadeo's whereabouts...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 45
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: And finally figure out what's happened to the village, to its inhabitants...
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 46
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: And why Mindveil is collapsing.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 47
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Now we're in this together... We're a team.
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 48
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Let's go, team!
name: INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER 49
chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: We have to do it, @NAME.

chapter: 215 INT. CÁMARA DEL CONSEJO DE LA ALDEA - ATARDECER

dialog: Well...

name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 2
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: But... I can't help feeling that constant weight.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 3
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: That urgency. That pressure.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 4
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: That... need to keep moving. To reach Parpadeo's lair, to find him as soon as possible.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 5
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Ah...
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 6
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: I think it might be a good idea to stop for a moment, take a deep breath, and rest.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 7
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: We need to shore up our next steps.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 8
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Prepare properly, grow, and sharpen the axe, as they say.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 9
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: It's important that we move quickly, yes, but also with confidence and steadily.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 10
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: And at the end of the day... We've stopped the village's devastation, and we've looked after the town.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 11
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Even if there are doubts to resolve, we shouldn't have to worry about them anymore.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 12
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Anyway...
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 13
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Let's light a campfire and sit down before we continue.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 14
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: There's something I'd like to tell you.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 15
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Now that's more like it!
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 16
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: How I've missed this!
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 17
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Especially after how cold it was in the Council...
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 18
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Well, a promise is a promise!
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 19
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Can you guess why this place was called Hushgrove?
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 20
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Because from up here, the ancient sages would look to the horizon in the most absolute calm. In total silence.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 21
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: With that, they sought to predict the future of Mindveil, and of their own village... through the stars. They were patient. They understood that good things take time.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 22
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: They watched. They thought. They reflected. They were patient.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 23
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: They understood that good things take time to arrive....
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 24
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: ...And that no news is sometimes the best news one can receive.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 25
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Now, no one looks to the sky.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 26
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: We've lowered our gaze to focus on the immediate.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 27
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: But when you strip someone of the ability to wait, you also strip them of their future.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 28
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Maybe that's why Hushgrove's gates were wide open...
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 29
chapter: 216 INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA

dialog: Because maybe there was no future left to protect, only shadows chasing glimmers.
name: INT. SALIDA TRASERA DE LA ALDEA - NOCHE CERRADA 30

dialog: And just stepping on it could weigh on us mentally...

dialog: Soren!

chapter: 217 EXT. CAMINO HACIA EL NORTE - AMANECER

name: EXT. CAMINO HACIA EL NORTE - AMANECER 31
chapter: 217 EXT. CAMINO HACIA EL NORTE - AMANECER

dialog: But... That would require a precision I no longer possess.
name: EXT. CAMINO HACIA EL NORTE - AMANECER 32
chapter: 217 EXT. CAMINO HACIA EL NORTE - AMANECER

dialog: Oh...

chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: Parpadeo...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 25
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: He's been one of the fastest warriors my eyes have ever had the chance to see.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 26
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: At times, he moved in a totally illogical way... Unprocessable...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 27
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: And even so...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 28
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: He failed.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 29
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: He tried to be everywhere. To cover all the space.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 30
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: And in the end, somehow... space devoured him.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 31
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 32
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: We came out victorious from that lair, yes...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 33
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: But now...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 34
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: I feel incomplete.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 35
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: My mind has escaped that crystal hell.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 36
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: But I think a part of my spirit has remained trapped in those mirrors forever.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 37
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: Easy, Soren...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 38
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: There's no doubt Parpadeo was a worthy enemy.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 39
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: He laid bare many of our own flaws...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 40
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: But that doesn't mean we can't learn from them, and overcome them.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 41
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: After all, we have something Parpadeo lacked...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 42
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: Discipline. Temperance. Self-control.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 43
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: And regarding that strange feeling...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 44
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: It may be that his influence wasn't the only one spreading through the kingdom.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 45
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: I think we'll soon find the answer you're looking for.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 46
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: It seems we still have a lot of work left to do in the north of the kingdom.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 47
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: Let's not waste any more time than strictly necessary...
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 48
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER

dialog: We have to find new threads to pull on.
name: INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER 49
chapter: 232 INT. SALIDA DEL LABERINTO DE ESPEJOS - AMANECER
